svg.title: What comes next
svg.metadata: {"source":"README.en.md#roadmap","mapping":"Illustrative planned sequence; no fixed dates or completed-work claim","rows":[["DAY 1","Check the radar reference","Test both sensors and align their space and time coordinates."],["DAY 2","Collect walking data","Record an empty room, then calibrate by slowly walking through it."],["DAYS 3–4","Compare models and test independently","Evaluate positioning models using separate recordings."],["DAYS 5–7","Test live tracking and refine it","Check Wi-Fi-only tracking, improve it, and repeat independent tests."],["DAYS 8–11","Test another room and complete final checks","Recalibrate, resolve remaining issues, validate and document the setup."],["DAYS 12–13","Experiment with two people","Integrate and independently evaluate two-person tracking."]]}

g.text: Project still in development · planned workdays, starting from Day 1
Test both sensors and align their space and time coordinates.
Record an empty room, then calibrate by slowly walking through it.
Evaluate positioning models using separate recordings.
Test live tracking and refine it
Check Wi-Fi-only tracking, improve it, and repeat independent tests.
Test another room and complete final checks
Recalibrate, resolve remaining issues, validate and document the setup.
Integrate and independently evaluate two-person tracking.
Planned sequence, not fixed dates. Each stage depends on passing the previous checks.
